title: Optimisation in practice: conditioning, momentum, mini-batches and adaptive methods
summary: Poor conditioning and the momentum method; non-convex landscapes and overparameterisation; the cost and variance of mini-batch gradients; adaptive methods (RMSprop, Adam); choosing and reporting optimiser hyperparameters.
